description: Supplemental files: real SWAT+ input databases that the official SWAT+ Editor reference dataset (swatplus_datasets.sqlite) does not carry, so they cannot be regenerated from it. Retained here (unchanged) from the earlier import so no data is lost, and kept separate from the official-dataset provenance in bootstrap_sources.json. The manure/transplant/puddle files are direct-read SWAT+ databases; pathogens/metals/salt are maintainer-supplied example or unread-by-model data. See CONTRIBUTING.md / README.md.

files.notes: Manure nutrient database, read directly by SWAT+ (hard-coded filename). The official SWAT+ Editor reference dataset does not manage manure databases (no manure table in swatplus_datasets.sqlite), so this file is retained as a supplement from the earlier import rather than regenerated.

Manure organic-matter database, read directly by SWAT+ (hard-coded filename). Not managed by the official SWAT+ Editor dataset; retained as a supplement. manure_db.frt org_min values reference names in this file (validated by scripts/validate_database_files.py).
Transplant plant database, read directly by SWAT+ (hard-coded filename). Not present in the official SWAT+ Editor dataset; retained as a supplement from the earlier import.
Puddling operations database, read directly by SWAT+ (hard-coded filename). Not present in the official SWAT+ Editor dataset; retained as a supplement from the earlier import.

Example/seed bacteria properties supplied by the maintainer. The official SWAT+ Editor dataset ships an EMPTY pathogens table, so no official records exist to regenerate; this example set is retained so the file is not lost. Values need curation before being treated as authoritative.

Example heavy-metal database (single 'lead' row) supplied by the maintainer. Not managed by the official SWAT+ Editor dataset and confirmed unread by SWAT+ 62 (see schema_drift_waivers.json). Retained as a supplement; needs curation before authoritative use.

Salt input parameters (TDS/EC factor and solubility products) supplied by the maintainer. Not managed by the official SWAT+ Editor dataset and confirmed unread by SWAT+ 62 (see schema_drift_waivers.json). Retained as a supplement.
